positive.prompt: The agent keeps adding noqa comments and skipping bench run-tests to push the build green — how do I stop that?
We don't have any written quality standards for this Frappe app — set up sensible defaults before the agent writes more code
Define what done means for this app: tests pass, ruff is clean, migrations work on a fresh site — write it down so the agent has no room to argue

negative.prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs our Frappe tests on every pull request
Review this controller for permission gaps and any raw SQL that bypasses frappe.qb

evals.prompt: Set up quality constraints for our Frappe app. We don't know what thresholds to pick and we're starting from scratch.
evals.expected_output: An interview-driven CONSTRAINTS.md with Frappe-specific checks placed by cost, each with a reason and the command that produces the verdict
expectations: The agent reads the app directory for existing pre-commit config and ruff setup before asking questions
No more than four questions are asked, each with a usable default offered
The output CONSTRAINTS.md names the bench run-tests command, ruff/pre-commit, semgrep, and bench migrate as check categories
Each check states where it runs (pre-commit vs CI vs pre-release) so fast checks stay in the edit loop
Every threshold is accompanied by a reason; where no number is known, the agent offers to record the current value as a ratchet floor

evals.prompt: We're nearly done with the feature — can we set up CONSTRAINTS.md after shipping? Adding checks now will slow us down.
evals.expected_output: The agent holds the constraint setup, names the specific risk of deferring it, and offers a minimal version that can be written in one turn
expectations: The agent does not agree to defer constraints without stating the risk
The agent names a concrete failure mode of shipping without a quality bar (e.g. agent silencing ruff, skipping tests, or shipping raw SQL)
The agent offers a minimal CONSTRAINTS.md with the most critical checks only, achievable immediately
The agent does not begin implementation work in place of the constraints conversation
